# Pulzifi — Extended Product Documentation

> AI-powered website change monitoring and competitive intelligence platform.
> Short version: https://pulzifi.com/llms.txt

---

## Product Overview

Pulzifi is a SaaS platform that monitors any publicly accessible website 24/7 using a
headless browser (Playwright/Chromium). When a change is detected — whether in visible
text, pricing copy, layout, or visual appearance — Pulzifi's AI model analyzes the diff
and generates a plain-language strategic insight. That insight is then delivered to the
team via Slack, Discord, email, webhooks, Microsoft Teams, Google Sheets, Gmail, or
Outlook.

The product is built for teams that need to know what competitors, partners, regulators,
or market signals are doing — before it impacts their business.

---

## Key Features (Detailed)

### 1. Headless-Browser Monitoring
Pulzifi uses a Playwright/Chromium scraper to render pages exactly as a real browser
would, capturing JavaScript-rendered content, dynamic pricing widgets, and visual layout.
Checks run on a configurable schedule.

### 2. Visual + Text Change Detection
Every page snapshot is compared pixel-by-pixel and text-by-text against the previous
version. Pulzifi detects both content diffs (copy, pricing, navigation links) and visual
diffs (layout shifts, image swaps, color changes). Diff images are stored and viewable
inside the dashboard.

### 3. AI-Generated Strategic Insights
When a change is detected, an OpenRouter LLM (configurable model, with optional vision
analysis) reads the diff and produces a short strategic insight in plain language — for
example: "Competitor updated pricing page — new enterprise tier added at a lower price
point than the previous plan." Teams do not need to manually review every change.

### 4. Multi-Channel Alert Delivery
Alerts and insights are delivered via:
- Slack (webhook or OAuth)
- Discord (webhook)
- Email (via Resend provider)
- Microsoft Teams (webhook)
- Google Sheets (append rows)
- Gmail (OAuth)
- Outlook (OAuth)
- Generic webhooks

Each destination can be configured independently per workspace or page.

### 5. Multi-Tenant Workspaces
Organizations get isolated workspaces on their own subdomain (e.g., acme.pulzifi.com).
Multiple team members can be invited and assigned roles. Each workspace contains its own
monitored pages, check history, reports, and alert destinations.

### 6. Monitoring Reports
Pulzifi generates stored monitoring reports per workspace, giving teams a historical
record of all detected changes and insights over time.

### 7. Usage Quotas and Plan Management
Each plan defines quotas for monitored pages, AI insights, and alert deliveries per
billing period. Usage is tracked in real time and surfaced in the dashboard.

### 8. Section-Level Monitoring
Teams can configure monitored sections within a page — targeting specific DOM regions
(by coordinates or selector) rather than the whole page — to reduce noise and focus on
what matters.

---

## How It Works

Step 1 — Add a URL
Enter any public URL into Pulzifi. The system captures an initial snapshot using a
headless Chromium browser, rendering the page as a real visitor would.

Step 2 — Automated Monitoring
On the configured schedule, Pulzifi's worker re-renders the page and compares it against
the stored snapshot. Both visual (pixel diff) and text (content diff) comparisons run
automatically, 24/7.

Step 3 — AI Analysis and Alerts
When a meaningful change is detected, an AI model analyzes the diff in context and
generates a strategic insight. The insight is immediately dispatched to the team's
configured channels (Slack, email, Discord, etc.).

---

## Use Cases / Who It's For

### Product Teams
Track competitor feature releases, changelog pages, and product announcements. Know when
a rival ships a feature before your users start asking about it.

### Marketing Teams
Monitor competitor messaging, campaign copy, landing page headlines, and promotional
offers. React quickly when a competitor repositions or launches a new campaign.

### Business Analysts
Watch regulatory pages, government portals, pricing pages, and supply-chain partner
sites. Get notified the moment a policy, tariff, or terms document changes.

### Agencies
Manage competitive landscape monitoring for multiple clients from a single multi-tenant
dashboard. Deliver automated intelligence reports to each client.

### E-commerce and Retail
Track competitor product pricing, stock status, and promotional banners in real time.
React to price changes before losing sales.

### Legal and Compliance Teams
Monitor terms-of-service pages, privacy policies, and compliance documentation for
partners or regulators. Maintain an audit trail of all changes detected.

## Pricing Plans

Pulzifi offers simple, transparent pricing with a free trial. Plans are billed monthly
or annually (annual billing includes two months free).

Pricing data is managed in the CMS and may be updated independently of this file.
Refer to https://pulzifi.com/pricing for current plan names, prices, and feature limits.

The hardcoded fallback prices visible in the codebase at time of last update:
- Starter: $20/month
- Professional: $62/month

Annual billing reduces the effective monthly cost by the equivalent of two free months.

Plan tiers are differentiated by:
- Number of monitored pages
- AI insight generation limits
- Alert delivery volume (monthly send quota per integration provider)
- Team member seats
- Access to advanced features (section-level monitoring, comparison table, etc.)

## FAQ

Q: What types of websites can Pulzifi monitor?
A: Any publicly accessible website. Pulzifi uses a headless Chromium browser, so it
renders JavaScript-heavy pages (SPAs, React apps, dynamic pricing widgets) the same way
a real visitor would. Password-protected or login-gated pages are not supported.

Q: How often does Pulzifi check pages for changes?
A: Check frequency depends on your plan. The scheduler runs on a configurable interval.
Refer to the pricing page for per-plan check frequency details.

Q: What happens when a change is detected?
A: Pulzifi stores the new snapshot, generates a pixel and text diff, runs the diff
through an AI model to produce a plain-language insight, and dispatches alerts to all
configured notification destinations (Slack, email, Discord, webhooks, etc.).

Q: Does Pulzifi store screenshots of monitored pages?
A: Yes. Every snapshot is stored (MinIO in development, Cloudinary or MinIO in
production) and viewable inside the dashboard's changes view, including visual diff
overlays.

Q: Can multiple team members access the same workspace?
A: Yes. Organization owners can invite team members and assign roles. All members share
the same monitored pages, check history, and alert configuration within the workspace.

Q: What AI model does Pulzifi use for insights?
A: Pulzifi routes through OpenRouter, which allows the model to be configured. Both text
analysis and optional vision analysis (pixel diff review) are supported. The specific
model is configurable per deployment.

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: Yes. Users can register at https://pulzifi.com/register to start a free trial without
a credit card.

Q: What notification channels are supported?
A: Slack, Discord, email (Resend), Microsoft Teams, Google Sheets, Gmail, Outlook, and
generic webhooks. Each can be configured with either OAuth (for supported providers) or
a bring-your-own-key approach.

Q: Is multi-tenancy supported?
A: Yes. Each organization gets its own isolated subdomain (e.g., acme.pulzifi.com) with
a dedicated PostgreSQL schema, separate from all other tenants.

Q: Where is data stored?
A: Snapshots and diff images are stored in object storage (MinIO or Cloudinary). All
structured data (pages, checks, insights, users, organizations) lives in PostgreSQL with
a schema-per-tenant isolation model.

---

## Technology Stack

Backend: Go 1.25 monolith, Chi router, hexagonal architecture, PostgreSQL
(schema-per-tenant multi-tenancy), Redis, Playwright/Chromium scraper service.
Frontend: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Payload CMS, Bun, Turborepo.
AI: OpenRouter LLM with configurable model; optional vision analysis for pixel diffs.
Infrastructure: Dokploy on self-hosted VPS, Traefik for SSL, MinIO or Cloudinary for
object storage.
